svg.title: Tech orbit and toolkit
svg.desc: Orbiting core tools (Python, PyTorch, LangGraph, FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions, Streamlit) and a toolkit grid for agents, retrieval, evaluation, serving and ML.
